# giac-openmath

> A data table mapping the nodes of GIAC's expression trees (the Giac computer algebra system, its C++ library) to OpenMath Content Dictionary symbols and back, with refused false friends. No code: giac-openmath.toml, and the same data as giac-openmath.json.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what is mapped, what is refused, how to use the table
- [Private CDs](docs/private-cds.md): giac_math1 and giac_procedures1, requests to GIAC inside scscp1.procedure_call, the rules for readers
- [Corpus](docs/fixtures.md): the shared test cases of OpenMath read into GIAC (test/fixtures/openmath-to-giac.json)
- [Format](docs/format.md): leaves, maps, patterns (placeholders, apply, bind), directions, status, refused entries, GIAC input forms
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Data

- [giac-openmath.toml](giac-openmath.toml): the source
- [giac-openmath.json](giac-openmath.json): generated from the TOML (just export)
